step: cook with coconut, roll in sugar

sources.text: No source recorded for how it is made yet.

steps.what: butter and grated coconut, to sweetened condensed milk

steps.note: It is stirred all the time on the stove until it pulls away from the side of the pan, the soft-ball stage.
It is spread on a greased plate and chilled until firm enough to shape.

steps.name: roll in sugar
steps.note: Small balls are rolled by greased hands and coated in sugar, or in desiccated coconut in some recipes.

links.name: The Cinnamon Jar: Beijinhos (Brazilian coconut kisses)

sources.text: The soft-ball stage, shaping and coating from Wikipedia; the temperature, cooking and chilling times from one recipe, so they are one cook's, not a standard.
